text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to make this formal by
reintroducing myself. I am Mejiro
Ardan,
and I look forward to training with you
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Now, before we begin...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Could I ask you to accompany me
somewhere this weekend?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, the weekend rolls
around...

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
We've arrived, Miss Ardan. Enjoy your day,
but do be careful... And
please, Trainer,
do look after her for us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After riding in a car owned by the Mejiro
family, we find ourselves at
an art museum.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no need to be nervous, Trainer.
Thank you for accompanying
us, Nanny. I
promise we'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Ardan's reassurance, I can't seem
to calm down. I anxiously
scan my
surroundings...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only for my eyes to land on the poster for
the exhibition we'll be
going to. The title
of this exhibition is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I've been meaning to see this
exhibition for a while now, but I
thought it
would be nice to have you accompany me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This show features a wide variety of
media—paintings, sculptures,

photography, film, and even traditional
arts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, they all have one thing in
common.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They are all works that were released
after
their respective creators
died.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head into the exhibition,
fully expecting
to be blown away by each
artist's final
work—their swan songs. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While there certainly are some
awe-inspiring pieces, there are also works
that leave me confused—I mention that it's
just like any other
art exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I suppose that is one way to look at
it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, Ardan and I make our way
through the exhibition, until we
reach a
door leading out of the museum.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There's one more artwork left. Trainer,
could we head to the forest
behind the
museum?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It seems that's where the final piece is
being displayed, and, well...
that's the
piece I wish to see the most.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I hope you don't mind this little detour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we head into the forest.
Judging from the lack of other attendees
on the path, it seems like very few people
know this
artwork is part of the exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But as we finally reach the spot...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Here it is. This is what I wanted to
see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What we find is a single painting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A faded, weathered painting that had
clearly been through its fair
share of rainy
days and blistering heat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It seems the artist's request was for this
piece to be placed outside,
and only
outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We stand there, taking in the painting for
what feels like an eternity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As I'm sure you know, I was born with a
fragile, weak body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the museum, we decided to
stop by a cafe. As we sit
there, Mejiro
Ardan continues on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But that was also the case for my sister,
and she ended up making a
miraculous
recovery. I suppose that gave me hope...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But unfortunately,
fate didn't see it fit to
have two miracles in one
place. I suppose
that would make miracles less special.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Our family doctor told me that my body
wouldn't be able to handle
racing. In fact,
he said it would only lead to disaster.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even now, my parents are vehemently
against my decision to race.
Just the other
day, they were on the phone with me,
crying about their fear of losing me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I think their fears partially stem from
the fact that I was originally
supposed to have
a twin... They worry that I will meet the
same fate as my stillborn sibling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yet despite all that...
I still want to race,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan looks up, and those
eyes—eyes I've seen burn with
conviction
countless times—are suddenly focused on
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I do not know when my body will give out
on me. Among the countless Umamusume
who shine so bright, my star may very well
burn
out the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just like that painting in the woods,
I may
fade away and be
forgotten. And yet, here
and now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I still wish to shine,
and I'm willing to do
whatever it takes to do so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even if my sparkle disappears in the blink
of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to leave my mark. I wish to prove
that I was here, in this
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Will you help me do that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ardan looks at me expectantly. In the
past, her resolve left me at a loss for
words, but I can't let that happen here.
When the words come
to me, I speak...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for testing you with such a
grim prediction. I was
worried you may not
be prepared for what may lie ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But I was wrong... You are far more
determined than I had ever
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan reaches out her hand, and I
give it a firm shake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I silently make a pact to help Mejiro
Ardan
shine, here and now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Apologies, Trainer, but I know something
about that painting that
you don't.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(That artist had a devout partner
supporting them through their life.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(They say the artist put the last of their
energy into that painting...
and dedicated
it to their lover.)
